description: Dated schedule slots transcribed from a weekly schedule poster.

date.description: Day cell of the slot as YYYY-MM-DD inside the poster week.

start.description: Printed start time as 24-hour HH:MM in the zone given in tz, or null.

end.description: Printed end time in the same format, or null.

tz.description: Time zone of start as printed, or null when the poster states none.

text.description: Everything written in the slot except date, weekday, and its times in every zone, copied as printed.

badges.description: Badges attached to the slot: the printed text, or the legend's text for an icon.
